name: codex-worklog
description: Keep an append-only semantic worklog in every Codex workspace and use it to recover context when needed.

interface.shortDescription: Local what, when, and why for every task
interface.longDescription: Maintains an append-only semantic worklog in the Codex session working directory and teaches the agent to use recent entries for careful context recovery.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recover the current task context from the workspace worklog and verify what is still true.
